item.title: Sierra College Selected to Join Aspen Institute
item.description: Sierra College has been selected to join the Aspen Institute College Excellence Program’s Unlocking Opportunity network

item.title: Sierra College Students Ride Local Transit Free
item.description: Sierra College and regional transit partners in Placer and Nevada counties are working to address a key barrier to educational access: reliable and affordable transportation.

item.title: Megan Wetzel Joins Sierra College Foundation
item.description: Megan Wetzel is the new Sierra College Foundation Associate Development Director.

item.title: Grand Opening of Student Housing
item.description: Sierra College today celebrated the Grand Opening of a new, centrally-located, 358-bed student housing facility on the Rocklin Campus.

item.title: Foundation Executive Director to retire in May
item.description: The Sierra College Foundation announced today that longtime Executive Director Sonbol Aliabadi will retire at the end of May 2026.

item.title: Foundation Started New Semester with Impactful Gifts
item.description: Sierra College Foundation (SCF) started a new semester after an impressive Year End Giving campaign, private gift and corporate grant program that closed out 2025. In addition to individual gifts…

item.title: Foundation Reaches 10 Bed Milestone
item.description: Sierra College Foundation reached a major milestone: Raising $2.5 million to endow 10 beds in perpetuity for Sierra Hall, the on-campus student housing complex.

item.title: SCF Names New Executive Director
item.description: Regional corporate and nonprofit leader Lori Rianda has been named the new Sierra College Foundation executive director.

item.title: New Science Building Groundbreaking Event
item.description: Sierra College leaders, faculty and students gathered to break ground on construction of a new science building on the Rocklin campus.

item.title: Sutter Health Invests in Healthcare Training
item.description: Sutter Health invested $2 million to expand Sierra’s award-winning Allied Health programs to train the next generation of healthcare professionals.

item.title: Men’s Swim Scores Fifth State Championship
item.description: The Sierra College Men’s Swim and Dive Team won its fifth consecutive state title, taking first at the 3C2A 2025 State Swimming and Diving Championship.

item.title: Sierra College Receives CAL FIRE Partnership Award
item.description: Sierra College was honored by the CAL FIRE Nevada-Yuba-Placer Unit with its “Partnership Award” for its commitment to public safety and community safety.

item.title: 2025 Sierra Workforce Summit Recap
item.description: Nearly 300 regional educators, employers, business and workforce training leaders attended Sierra Workforce Summit to align workforce development efforts.

item.title: Foundation Raises $3Million-plus for Students
item.description: Sierra College Foundation closed out 2024-25 by awarding nearly $350,000 in scholarships to more than 200 local students to help pay for school/living costs.
